title: HarnessKit overlay lock file
description: Owned by a CONSUMING overlay (e.g. a private overlay-side distribution), not by the public core. Pins the exact public-core commit the overlay was built/tested against. The public core provides this schema, a generator, and a validator -- it never creates or owns the real lock file for any specific overlay.

overlay_name.description: Name of the consuming overlay, e.g. 'example-internal'. Never a personal or machine-specific path.

core_commit.description: Full 40-char git SHA of the public HarnessKit core commit this overlay is pinned to.

core_repo_url.description: Optional: where the public core lives, if published. Null for a purely local/private consumption today.

generator_version.description: Identifies which generate-harnesskit-lock.js produced this, for forward-compat.
